dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 VIEW — Listed Building polygons (layer 3)
data_date: 2026-09-11 (Historic England listed-buildings polygon download page update)
evidence_slice: Historic England's current National Heritage List for England (NHLE) open-data service exposes layer 3 as 'Listed Building polygons' with esriGeometryPolygon geometry and fields including ListEntry, Name, Grade and area_ha. Historic England metadata states polygons are available for listed buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011 and that area_ha is only populated where building footprint has been mapped. NHLE List Entry 1495589 is Exeter Central Station, Grade II, first listed 24 July 2026, with explicit railway-station identity/type evidence. The exact official layer-3 query for ListEntry 1495589 with returnGeometry=true and GeoJSON output was inaccessible through the available retrieval channel before any feature payload was read.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer 3 is esriGeometryPolygon and metadata says area_ha is populated where building footprint has been mapped; the exact ListEntry 1495589 feature payload/coordinates were not retrievable.
field_evidence.type_use: Official NHLE List Entry 1495589 is Exeter Central Station; summary describes a purpose-built Southern Railway station, first listed 24 July 2026.
field_evidence.heritage: Official NHLE record identifies List Entry 1495589 as Grade II.
